---
name: Dependency eligibility service

on: # zizmor: ignore[dangerous-triggers] -- Trusted listener delegates only immutable shared code; it never executes candidate code.
  schedule:
    - cron: "23 * * * *"
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    types: [requested, completed]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  eligibility:
    name: Trusted dependency metadata
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'schedule' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && (github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' || github.event.workflow_run.event == 'merge_group'))
    permissions:
      actions: write
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
      statuses: write
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-dependency-eligibility.yml@41d7f8b868351621c4e60fbeedd9fce5955f7897 # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      automation-sha: 41d7f8b868351621c4e60fbeedd9fce5955f7897
